meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Detect security vulnerabilities and governance violations across delivered code, configurations, and deployed environments. Activate after implementation or periodically as a governance check.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检测代码与配置中的安全漏洞和治理违规
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在代码或环境上线前自动发现安全风险与合规问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automatically find security risks and compliance issues before deploying code or environments

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会扫描代码和配置文件，发现安全漏洞和治理违规，并输出带严重等级的漏洞报告和修复步骤。
howto.when: 在代码实现后作为安全门禁触发，或定期对活跃项目检查，以及安全规则更新时。

say.text: 检查我刚刚写的代码有无安全漏洞。
say.note: Claude会扫描代码并报告漏洞。

say.text: 扫描我的配置文件，查找密钥泄露。
say.note: Claude会检测配置中的不安全项。

say.text: 评估当前部署环境的安全合规情况。
say.note: Claude会检查环境并给出合规报告。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans code and configuration files to detect security vulnerabilities and governance violations, outputting a severity-ranked vulnerability report with remediation steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers as a security gate after implementation, periodically on active projects, or when security rules are added or updated.

say_en.text: Check my recently written code for security vulnerabilities.
say_en.note: Claude will scan the code and report vulnerabilities.

say_en.text: Scan my configuration files for secret exposure.
say_en.note: Claude will detect unsafe patterns in configs.

say_en.text: Evaluate the security compliance of the current deployment environment.
say_en.note: Claude will check the environment and provide a compliance report.
